---
title: "Payout and exceedance explorer"
subtitle: "How the tail weight α, the tail level β and the budget loading κ shape a step payout"
description: "Move α, β or the budget loading κ, switch between the MSE, E[U] and weighted-CVaR objectives, and see the step payout of one site, the payout relative to the MSE design, and the out-of-sample exceedance curves of the uncovered loss."
echo: false
page-layout: full
css: explorer.css
---

<!--
The payout explorer (MAR-54). It reads the explorer bundle that the Site
workflow solves and exports on every build from site/configs/explorer.yaml
(MAR-208, MAR-213) and writes into the rendered site at bundles/explorer/,
after the render: so every bundle file is read here at run time, with a
relative URL. Nothing on this page filters rows by evaluation split: the
bundle holds the out-of-sample ("test") rows only, and the page states the
filter from manifest.split_filter. Layout rules: explorer.css.
-->

A parametric cover pays an amount set by a hazard index, here the wind speed at a site, not by the loss itself. So it leaves part of the loss uncovered. This page shows how the design of a **step payout** (one payout level per wind-speed bin) changes with the objective it is calibrated for and with that objective's parameters. Every number comes from a precomputed bundle: the page never runs an optimisation.

Each design minimises one of three objectives over the years it is calibrated on, where $L$ is a year's loss at the site, $\pi$ its payout and $U = \sum_{\text{events}} (L_e - \pi_e)^+$ its uncovered loss:

- **Residual loss (MSE):** $\mathbb{E}[(L - \pi)^2]$, which counts over-payment like under-payment.
- **Expected uncovered loss, E[U]:** $\mathbb{E}[U]$.
- **Weighted CVaR:** $\alpha\,\mathrm{CVaR}_\beta(U) + (1-\alpha)\,\mathbb{E}[U]$. $\mathrm{CVaR}_\beta(U)$ is the mean of the worst $1-\beta$ share of years, so **α** sets the weight of the tail and **β** how far out the tail starts. α and β are parameters of this objective only.

Every design meets the same budget: its premium, the expected annual payout over the calibration years (pure pricing), is at most **κ** times the expected annual loss. The bundle holds one sweep per parameter, one at a time around a baseline (α = 0.9, β = 0.99, κ = 1.0); moving one keeps the other two at their baseline values. The number of bins is fixed at 15: this bundle has no bin-count sweep.

The page shows what the designs are and how they behave on years they were not calibrated on. It does not rank the objectives: whatever the charts show holds for the setup stated under each chart, not in general.

```{ojs}
//| output: false
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// -- The bundle ---------------------------------------------------------------
// Written by `parametric-insurance-design export-site site/configs/explorer.yaml
// --split test` into the rendered site (site/README.md, "Bundles").
manifestResult = FileAttachment("../bundles/explorer/manifest.json").json().then(
  (m) => ({manifest: m}),
  (error) => ({error})
)
manifest = {
  if (manifestResult.error) {
    throw new Error("The explorer bundle is not in this build of the site (bundles/explorer/manifest.json).");
  }
  const m = manifestResult.manifest;
  if (m.format !== "parametric-insurance-design/site-bundle" || m.format_version !== 1) {
    throw new Error(`unsupported bundle: ${m.format} version ${m.format_version}`);
  }
  // Every file this page reads must be in the manifest.
  const listed = new Set(m.files.map((f) => f.path));
  for (const group of Object.keys(fileNames)) {
    for (const path of Object.values(fileNames[group])) {
      if (!listed.has(path)) throw new Error(`the bundle has no ${path}`);
    }
  }
  return m;
}
fileNames = ({
  baseline: {payouts: "baseline.payouts.arrow", exceedance: "baseline.exceedance.arrow"},
  alpha: {payouts: "sweep.alpha.payouts.arrow", exceedance: "sweep.alpha.exceedance.arrow"},
  beta: {payouts: "sweep.beta.payouts.arrow", exceedance: "sweep.beta.exceedance.arrow"},
  budget_loading: {payouts: "sweep.budget_loading.payouts.arrow", exceedance: "sweep.budget_loading.exceedance.arrow"}
})
// FileAttachment needs literal names (Quarto resolves them at render time).
files = ({
  baseline: {
    payouts: FileAttachment("../bundles/explorer/baseline.payouts.arrow"),
    exceedance: FileAttachment("../bundles/explorer/baseline.exceedance.arrow")
  },
  alpha: {
    payouts: FileAttachment("../bundles/explorer/sweep.alpha.payouts.arrow"),
    exceedance: FileAttachment("../bundles/explorer/sweep.alpha.exceedance.arrow")
  },
  beta: {
    payouts: FileAttachment("../bundles/explorer/sweep.beta.payouts.arrow"),
    exceedance: FileAttachment("../bundles/explorer/sweep.beta.exceedance.arrow")
  },
  budget_loading: {
    payouts: FileAttachment("../bundles/explorer/sweep.budget_loading.payouts.arrow"),
    exceedance: FileAttachment("../bundles/explorer/sweep.budget_loading.exceedance.arrow")
  }
})
runIndex = { manifest; return FileAttachment("../bundles/explorer/runs.json").json(); }
locationIndex = { manifest; return FileAttachment("../bundles/explorer/locations.json").json(); }
// Arrow table to plain objects: dictionary columns decode to strings, int32
// to numbers, and null stays null (payouts.lower: -inf, see the manifest).
rows = (table) => table.toArray().map((row) => row.toJSON())
// One load per group, kept for the session: switching back is instant.
tableCache = new Map()
loadGroup = (group) => {
  if (!tableCache.has(group)) {
    const f = files[group];
    tableCache.set(group, Promise.all([f.payouts.arrow(), f.exceedance.arrow()])
      .then(([p, e]) => ({payouts: rows(p), exceedance: rows(e)})));
  }
  return tableCache.get(group);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// -- Runs, sites, labels -------------------------------------------------------
runById = new Map(runIndex.runs.map((r) => [r.run_id, r]))
objectiveOrder = ["mse", "expected_uncovered", "weighted_cvar"]
objectiveLabel = ({mse: "Residual loss (MSE)", expected_uncovered: "Expected uncovered loss E[U]", weighted_cvar: "Weighted CVaR"})
objectiveShort = ({mse: "MSE", expected_uncovered: "E[U]", weighted_cvar: "weighted CVaR"})
// The baseline design of each objective (the config's single runs).
baselineRuns = Object.fromEntries(manifest.runs.baseline.map((id) => runById.get(id)).map((r) => [r.objective, r]))
objectives = objectiveOrder.filter((o) => o in baselineRuns)
parameterOrder = ["alpha", "beta", "budget_loading"].filter((p) => p in manifest.runs.sweeps)
parameterSymbol = ({alpha: "α", beta: "β", budget_loading: "κ"})
parameterName = ({alpha: "α, tail weight", beta: "β, tail level", budget_loading: "κ, budget loading"})
budgetLoading = manifest.setup.constraints.find((c) => c.kind === "budget")?.loading
// The baseline value of a parameter: α and β of the weighted-CVaR design, κ of the budget.
baselineValue = (p) => p === "budget_loading" ? budgetLoading : baselineRuns.weighted_cvar?.parameters[p]
runValue = (r, p) => p === "budget_loading" ? r.parameters.budget_loading : r.parameters[p]
locations = locationIndex.locations
siteName = (l) => l.name.replaceAll("_", " ")
currency = manifest.eventset.loss.currency
indexUnit = manifest.eventset.index.unit
indexLabel = indexUnit === "m/s" ? "Wind speed at the site" : "Index at the site"
nYears = manifest.eventset.n_years
nTrain = Math.floor(nYears * manifest.setup.split.train_fraction)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// -- Formats and colours -------------------------------------------------------
// Money: one unit per axis, chosen from the axis' largest value, so that the
// axis ticks (Plot's own, on the scaled values) are always distinct.
moneyUnit = (max) => max >= 1e9 ? {div: 1e9, short: "bn", long: "billion"}
  : max >= 1e6 ? {div: 1e6, short: "M", long: "million"}
  : max >= 1e3 ? {div: 1e3, short: "k", long: "thousand"}
  : {div: 1, short: "", long: ""}
fmtMoney = (v) => {
  const u = moneyUnit(Math.abs(v));
  return `${d3.format(",.3~r")(v / u.div)}${u.short ? " " + u.short : ""} ${currency}`;
}
// Exact to the unit (for the tables). Rounding can give "-0": show 0.
fmtExact = (v) => d3.format(",.0f")(Math.round(v) === 0 ? 0 : v)
fmtPct = (v) => v == null ? "undefined" : `${d3.format(",.0f")(v)} %`
fmtYears = d3.format(",")
// The site's light theme (flatly) or dark theme (darkly): Quarto sets the
// body class. Colours: the payout blue and the uncovered-loss orange pass the
// colour-vision checks on both surfaces (white, #222); the loss is a muted
// grey and dashed, so it never relies on colour alone.
dark = Generators.observe((notify) => {
  const check = () => notify(document.body.classList.contains("quarto-dark"));
  check();
  const observer = new MutationObserver(check);
  observer.observe(document.body, {attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["class"]});
  return () => observer.disconnect();
})
colours = dark
  ? {payout: "#3987e5", uncovered: "#d95926", loss: "#a3a19a", reference: "#8a8a8a"}
  : {payout: "#2a78d6", uncovered: "#eb6834", loss: "#6f6d67", reference: "#898781"}
// The width of the chart column (not the page): the controls sit beside it on wide screens.
chartWidth = Generators.observe((notify) => {
  const el = document.getElementById("explorer-charts");
  const observer = new ResizeObserver(([entry]) => notify(Math.max(280, Math.floor(entry.contentRect.width))));
  observer.observe(el);
  notify(Math.max(280, el.clientWidth));
  return () => observer.disconnect();
})
chartHeight = Math.round(Math.min(360, Math.max(240, chartWidth * 0.55)))
```

```{ojs}
decimals = d3.max(sweepValues, (v) => (String(v).split(".")[1] ?? "").length)
sliderStep = +d3.min(d3.pairs(sweepValues), ([a, b]) => b - a).toFixed(decimals)
```

```{ojs}
  label: parameterSymbol[parameter],

  format: (v) => v.toFixed(decimals),

})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// The sweep points of the chosen objective. α and β are parameters of the
// weighted-CVaR objective only: for MSE and E[U] their sweeps have no points.
points = manifest.runs.sweeps[parameter]
  .map((p) => ({value: p.value, run: runById.get(p.run_id)}))
  .filter((p) => p.run.objective === objective)
  .sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a.value, b.value))
applies = points.length > 0
// Snap to the nearest exported sweep point.
point = applies ? d3.least(points, (p) => Math.abs(p.value - requested)) : null
run = applies ? point.run : baselineRuns[objective]
group = applies ? parameter : "baseline"
// The other designs of the sweep, drawn faintly behind the one shown.
otherRuns = applies ? points.filter((p) => p !== point).map((p) => p.run) : []
// The slider does nothing when the parameter is not one of the objective's:
// disable it without re-creating it (so it keeps its value).
{
  for (const input of viewof requested.querySelectorAll("input")) input.disabled = !applies;
}
```

::: {#explorer-charts .g-col-12 .g-col-lg-8}

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// -- Data of the charts ----------------------------------------------------------
data = loadGroup(group)
base = loadGroup("baseline")
attachment = manifest.setup.payout.attachment
limit = manifest.setup.payout.limit
payoutX = [attachment - 5, limit + 5]
// A run's bins at the site, in order.
binsOf = (table, runId) => table
  .filter((d) => d.run_id === runId && d.entity_id === siteId)
  .sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a.param_index, b.param_index))
// A step function as a polyline: each bin's level from its lower to its upper
// edge, so consecutive bins join with a vertical riser. Below the attachment,
// a "first_bin" design pays the first bin's level (to the axis' left edge), a
// "zero" design has its own zero row (lower null: -inf). At and above the
// limit, the index falls into the last bin.
stepLine = (bins, runId) => {
  if (bins.length === 0) return [];
  const out = [];
  const first = bins[0];
  if (first.below_attachment === "first_bin" && first.lower > payoutX[0]) {
    out.push({run_id: runId, x: payoutX[0], y: first.value}, {run_id: runId, x: first.lower, y: first.value});
  }
  for (const b of bins) {
    out.push({run_id: runId, x: b.lower ?? payoutX[0], y: b.value}, {run_id: runId, x: b.upper, y: b.value});
  }
  const last = bins[bins.length - 1];
  out.push({run_id: runId, x: payoutX[1], y: last.value});
  return out;
}
selectedBins = binsOf(data.payouts, run.run_id)
otherLines = otherRuns.flatMap((r) => stepLine(binsOf(data.payouts, r.run_id), r.run_id))
selectedLine = stepLine(selectedBins, run.run_id)
payoutMax = d3.max([...selectedLine, ...otherLines], (d) => d.y)
payoutUnit = moneyUnit(payoutMax)
```

### Step payout

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  width: chartWidth,
  height: chartHeight,
  marginLeft: 52,
  style: {background: "transparent"},
  x: {domain: payoutX, label: `${indexLabel} (${indexUnit}) →`},
  y: {domain: [0, (payoutMax / payoutUnit.div) * 1.05], grid: true, label: `↑ Payout per event (${currency} ${payoutUnit.long})`},
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleX([attachment, limit], {stroke: colours.reference, strokeDasharray: "2,3"}),
    Plot.text([attachment, limit], {x: (d) => d, text: (d, i) => i === 0 ? "attachment" : "limit", frameAnchor: "top", dx: 3, textAnchor: "start", fill: "currentColor", fillOpacity: 0.7}),
    Plot.ruleY([0]),
    Plot.line(otherLines, {x: "x", y: (d) => d.y / payoutUnit.div, z: "run_id", stroke: colours.payout, strokeOpacity: 0.25, strokeWidth: 1}),
    Plot.line(selectedLine, {x: "x", y: (d) => d.y / payoutUnit.div, stroke: colours.payout, strokeWidth: 2.5}),
    Plot.tip(selectedBins, Plot.pointerX({
      x: (d) => (d.lower + d.upper) / 2,
      y: (d) => d.value / payoutUnit.div,
      title: (d) => `${indexLabel}: ${d.lower.toFixed(1)}–${d.upper.toFixed(1)} ${indexUnit}\nPays ${fmtMoney(d.value)}`
    }))
  ]
})
```

The payout of an event is the level of the bin its wind speed falls in; below the attachment the design pays the first bin's level, at and above the limit the last bin's.</p>`

### Payout relative to the MSE design

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// The thesis' normalised payout: each bin's level relative to the level of
// the residual-loss (MSE) design in the same bin, at the same κ. A bin where
// the MSE design pays zero, to solver precision (1e-6 of its largest level, as
// in the viz package), has no relative value and is left out.
benchmarkRun = parameter === "budget_loading" && applies
  ? manifest.runs.sweeps.budget_loading.map((p) => runById.get(p.run_id))
      .find((r) => r.objective === "mse" && r.parameters.budget_loading === run.parameters.budget_loading)
  : baselineRuns.mse
benchmarkTable = group === "budget_loading" ? data.payouts : base.payouts
benchmarkBins = binsOf(benchmarkTable, benchmarkRun.run_id)
benchmarkScale = d3.max(benchmarkBins, (d) => Math.abs(d.value))
relativeBins = (bins) => bins.filter((b) => b.param_index >= 0).map((b) => {
  const bench = benchmarkBins.find((c) => c.param_index === b.param_index);
  const zero = !bench || Math.abs(bench.value) <= 1e-6 * benchmarkScale;
  return {...b, benchmark: bench?.value ?? null, relative: zero ? null : (b.value / bench.value) * 100};
})
// Each bin from its lower to its upper edge; an undefined bin breaks the line.
relativeLine = (bins, runId) => relativeBins(bins).flatMap((b) => [
  {run_id: runId, x: b.lower, y: b.relative},
  {run_id: runId, x: b.upper, y: b.relative}
])
selectedRelative = relativeBins(selectedBins)
relativeSelectedLine = relativeLine(selectedBins, run.run_id)
relativeOtherLines = parameter === "budget_loading" ? [] : otherRuns.flatMap((r) => relativeLine(binsOf(data.payouts, r.run_id), r.run_id))
relativeCap = 300
relativeMax = Math.min(relativeCap, Math.max(150, d3.max([...relativeSelectedLine, ...relativeOtherLines], (d) => d.y) ?? 0))
relativeClipped = [...relativeSelectedLine, ...relativeOtherLines].some((d) => d.y != null && d.y > relativeCap)
relativeUndefined = selectedRelative.filter((b) => b.relative == null).length
```

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  width: chartWidth,
  height: chartHeight,
  marginLeft: 52,
  style: {background: "transparent"},
  x: {domain: [attachment, limit], label: `${indexLabel} (${indexUnit}) →`},
  y: {domain: [0, relativeMax * 1.05], grid: true, label: "↑ Payout relative to the MSE design (%)"},
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleY([100], {stroke: colours.reference, strokeDasharray: "4,3"}),
    Plot.text([100], {y: (d) => d, text: () => "MSE design = 100 %", frameAnchor: "left", dx: 4, dy: -7, textAnchor: "start", fill: "currentColor", fillOpacity: 0.7}),
    Plot.ruleY([0]),
    Plot.line(relativeOtherLines, {x: "x", y: "y", z: "run_id", stroke: colours.payout, strokeOpacity: 0.25, strokeWidth: 1, clip: true}),
    Plot.line(relativeSelectedLine, {x: "x", y: "y", stroke: colours.payout, strokeWidth: 2.5, clip: true}),
    Plot.tip(selectedRelative.filter((b) => b.relative != null), Plot.pointerX({
      x: (d) => (d.lower + d.upper) / 2,
      y: (d) => Math.min(d.relative, relativeMax),
      title: (d) => `${indexLabel}: ${d.lower.toFixed(1)}–${d.upper.toFixed(1)} ${indexUnit}\nThis design: ${fmtMoney(d.value)}\nMSE design: ${fmtMoney(d.benchmark)}\nRatio: ${fmtPct(d.relative)}`
    }))
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
html`<p class="chart-caption">Each bin's payout divided by the payout of the residual-loss (MSE) design${parameter === "budget_loading" && applies ? " at the same κ" : ` at κ = ${benchmarkRun.parameters.budget_loading}`}, in percent: 100 % means the same payout as the MSE design in that bin.${objective === "mse" ? " The design shown is the MSE design itself." : ""}${relativeUndefined > 0 ? ` ${relativeUndefined} ${relativeUndefined === 1 ? "bin is" : "bins are"} left out: the MSE design pays nothing there, so the ratio is undefined.` : ""}${relativeClipped ? ` The axis stops at ${relativeCap} %: higher ratios are cut off (the table below has every value).` : ""}${parameter === "budget_loading" ? ### Exceedance curves of the uncovered loss
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
subjectId = subjectLevel === "portfolio" ? "portfolio" : siteId
curveRows = (runId) => data.exceedance.filter((d) =>
  d.run_id === runId && d.level === subjectLevel && d.subject_id === subjectId && d.curve === curveKind)
curves = curveRows(run.run_id).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a.return_period, b.return_period))
otherUncovered = otherRuns.flatMap((r) => curveRows(r.run_id).filter((d) => d.quantity === "uncovered"))
  .sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a.return_period, b.return_period))
returnPeriods = [...new Set(curves.map((d) => d.return_period))].sort(d3.ascending)
exceedanceMax = d3.max([...curves, ...otherUncovered], (d) => d.value)
exceedanceUnit = moneyUnit(exceedanceMax)
quantityLabel = ({loss: "Loss", payout: "Payout", uncovered: "Uncovered loss"})
```

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  width: chartWidth,
  height: chartHeight,
  marginLeft: 52,
  marginBottom: 40,
  style: {background: "transparent"},
  x: {type: "log", domain: d3.extent(returnPeriods), label: null},
  y: {domain: [0, (exceedanceMax / exceedanceUnit.div) * 1.05], grid: true, label: `↑ ${curveKind === "aep" ? "Annual total" : "Largest event of the year"} (${currency} ${exceedanceUnit.long})`},
  color: {
    domain: ["loss", "payout", "uncovered"],
    range: [colours.loss, colours.payout, colours.uncovered],
    tickFormat: (q) => quantityLabel[q],
    legend: true
  },
  marks: [
    // Tick and label every return period of the bundle: a log axis labels
    // only some of them, whatever its tickFormat.
    Plot.axisX(returnPeriods, {tickFormat: () => "", label: "Return period (years) →", labelOffset: 34}),
    Plot.text(returnPeriods, {x: (d) => d, text: (d) => String(d), frameAnchor: "bottom", lineAnchor: "top", dy: 9}),
    Plot.ruleY([0]),
    Plot.line(otherUncovered, {x: "return_period", y: (d) => d.value / exceedanceUnit.div, z: "run_id", stroke: colours.uncovered, strokeOpacity: 0.25, strokeWidth: 1}),
    Plot.line(curves.filter((d) => d.quantity === "loss"), {x: "return_period", y: (d) => d.value / exceedanceUnit.div, stroke: colours.loss, strokeWidth: 1.5, strokeDasharray: "5,3"}),
    Plot.line(curves.filter((d) => d.quantity === "payout"), {x: "return_period", y: (d) => d.value / exceedanceUnit.div, stroke: colours.payout, strokeWidth: 1.5}),
    Plot.line(curves.filter((d) => d.quantity === "uncovered"), {x: "return_period", y: (d) => d.value / exceedanceUnit.div, stroke: colours.uncovered, strokeWidth: 2.5}),
    Plot.dot(curves, {x: "return_period", y: (d) => d.value / exceedanceUnit.div, fill: "quantity", r: 3}),
    Plot.tip(curves, Plot.pointer({
      x: "return_period",
      y: (d) => d.value / exceedanceUnit.div,
      title: (d) => `${quantityLabel[d.quantity]}, ${d.return_period}-year return period\n${fmtMoney(d.value)}`
    }))
  ]
})
```

"AEP: each year's total over its events, the quantity the objectives are calibrated on." : "OEP: each year's largest event."}</p>`

## Setup {#setup}

```{ojs}
//| output: false
noise = manifest.setup.basis_risk.noise
threshold = manifest.setup.basis_risk.threshold
portfolioText = `the thesis portfolio, ${locations.length} sites in Miami (${locations.map((l) => l.location_id).join(", ")})`
basisRiskText = `the thesis noise layer: ${noise.kind} noise on the index, level ${noise.level}, ${noise.n_copies} noisy copies of each event (seed ${noise.seed}), bounded to ${noise.bounds.join("–")} ${indexUnit}; events with ${threshold.column} below ${threshold.value} ${indexUnit} dropped`
pricingText = `${manifest.setup.pricing.kind} pricing (premium = expected annual payout); budget: premium at most κ times the expected annual loss`
splitText = `${manifest.setup.split.kind}: designs calibrated on years ${fmtYears(0)}–${fmtYears(nTrain - 1)}, curves evaluated out of sample on years ${fmtYears(nTrain)}–${fmtYears(nYears - 1)}`
splitFilter = manifest.split_filter?.eval_split
payoutText = `${manifest.setup.payout.kind} payout, ${manifest.setup.payout.n_bins} equal bins from ${attachment} to ${limit} ${indexUnit} (no bin-count sweep in this bundle)`
// The setup line under each chart: everything a number on it depends on,
// in short; the table below has the long form.
setupNote = (kind) => {
  const kappa = run.parameters.budget_loading;
  const where = subjectLevel === "portfolio" && kind === "exceedance"
    ? `whole portfolio (sum over the ${locations.length} sites)`
    : `site ${site.location_id}`;
  const parts = [
    `the thesis portfolio (${locations.length} sites in Miami), ${where}`,
    `${run.scope} scope`,
    designLine,
    ...(kind === "relative" ? [`benchmark: the MSE design at κ = ${benchmarkRun.parameters.budget_loading}`] : []),
    `${manifest.setup.payout.n_bins} bins from ${attachment} to ${limit} ${indexUnit}`,
    `${manifest.setup.basis} basis`,
    `basis-risk model: the thesis noise layer (${noise.kind}, level ${noise.level}, ${noise.n_copies} copies)`,
    `${manifest.setup.pricing.kind} pricing, κ = ${kappa}`,
    kind === "exceedance"
      ? `${manifest.setup.split.kind} split, evaluated out of sample on the test years ${fmtYears(nTrain)}–${fmtYears(nYears - 1)} (eval_split = "${splitFilter}")`
      : `${manifest.setup.split.kind} split, calibrated on the train years ${fmtYears(0)}–${fmtYears(nTrain - 1)}`
  ];
  return html`<p class="setup-note"><strong>Setup:</strong> ${parts.join("; ")}. <a href="#setup">Full setup</a>.</p>`;
}
setupRows = {
  const s = manifest.setup;
  const e = manifest.eventset;
  const rows = [
    ["Portfolio", html`${portfolioText}. ${locations.map((l, i) => html`${i ? "; " : ""}${l.location_id} ${siteName(l)} (${fmtMoney(l.value)})`)}`],
    ["Event set", `${e.hazard.name}: ${e.hazard.release}. ${fmtYears(e.n_years)} simulated years; licence ${e.licence}`],
    ["Index", `${e.index.definition} (${e.index.unit})`],
    ["Loss", `${e.scenario}`],
    ["Design", `${run.scope} scope: each site calibrated on its own. ${designLine}`],
    ["Payout", payoutText],
    ["Basis", `${s.basis}: an outcome is a simulated year, its uncovered loss the sum over its events`],
    ["Basis-risk model", basisRiskText],
    ["Pricing", pricingText],
    ["Split", splitText],
    ["Rows in the bundle", splitFilter ? `eval_split = "${splitFilter}" only: the exceedance curves are out of sample` : "no split filter"],
    ["Evaluation", `CVaR level of the reported KPIs ${s.evaluation.beta}; return periods ${returnPeriods.join(", ")} years`],
    ["Sweeps", parameterOrder.map((p) => `${parameterSymbol[p]}: ${[...new Set(manifest.runs.sweeps[p].map((q) => q.value))].join(", ")}`).join("; ")],
    ["Bundle", manifest.label],
    ["Config", `${manifest.config.name}, ${manifest.config.hash}`],
    ["Run", `${run.run_id}${run.problems.find((p) => p.problem_id === siteId) ? `, problem ${siteId}: ${run.problems.find((p) => p.problem_id === siteId).status}` : ""}`]
  ];
  if (showPremium && problem) rows.splice(9, 0, ["Premium", `${fmtMoney(problem.premium)} a year, priced on the calibration years`]);
  return rows;
}
```

```{ojs}
html`<table class="setup-table"><tbody>${setupRows.map(([k, v]) => html`<tr><th scope="row">${k}</th><td>${v}</td></tr>`)}</tbody></table>`
```

The bundle is written by `parametric-insurance-design export-site site/configs/explorer.yaml --split test` on every build of the site, from the config [`site/configs/explorer.yaml`](https://github.com/marc272/parametric-insurance-design/blob/main/site/configs/explorer.yaml) in the [repository](https://github.com/marc272/parametric-insurance-design). Its files and their SHA-256 are listed in [`bundles/explorer/manifest.json`](../bundles/explorer/manifest.json).
